reviews.title: Recommended Laptop Upgrade for Windows 11
reviews.comment: This item was purchased to upgrade the SDRAM on an ASUS Vivobook 17 laptop.  The additional memory was essential following the upgrade to Windows 11.  I was having to disable so many of the new features and employ Task Manager to stop applications that were running in the background, else the operating system would simply freeze up after an hour or so after booting up.  Running multiple applications at the same time was out of the question.  This item was compatible with my ASUS unit and replaced an existing 4GB DDR4 that boosted the total memory to the 20GB maximum.  The laptop's performance is much better now.
reviews.author: Elastic Habit
